author: Animalogic
description:
We have a brand new cat! For the first time in over 100 years scientists have discovered a new species, and the most amazing thing is that it was a tiger cat who had been found as a kitten on the side of the road. In the same research, scientists also found evidence to elevate 2 other subspecies to full species. So check out this kitty galore as we dive into the brand new world of tiger cats.

Examining the nature of the beast.

From apex predators to the planet's strangest creatures, Animalogic goes deep into the science, behavior, and biology of the animal kingdom, one species at a time.
